threads.note: Last mentioned Apr 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: We'd like to move towards 26%, but on a longer-term basis.

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: We want to exit at 25% plus and strive to achieve it sooner rather than later.

threads.title: EBITDA margin target band
threads.note: Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: we want to inch closer to our 26% to 28% band and we'll make all efforts to climb towards 26%.

threads.title: North America growth outlook FY27
threads.note: Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.quote: We are optimistic that North America will return to better growth than before.

threads.title: FY27 order book target
threads.note: Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: If this trend continues, we will be somewhere closer to about US$38-39 billion for the year.

threads.title: FY27 revenue aspiration

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: We are optimistic, and we'll take every step that's required to see we reach the aspiration of having a revenue better than FY '25.

threads.title: Workforce restructuring FY27
threads.note: Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: Sudeep Kunnumal

threads.title: HyperVault 1 GW build‑out
threads.note: Last mentioned Apr 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: the promise we see in our HyperVault Business – which has made significant progress this quarter on its journey to build out 1 GW of capacity.

threads.title: SG&A elevated next quarters
threads.note: Last mentioned Apr 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: Some part of it will see an elevated increase, both in the absolute amount as well as in percentage of revenue.

threads.title: Restructuring program completion
threads.note: Last mentioned Apr 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: The restructuring program that we started, we have completed that program.

threads.title: Seasonality expectation next quarters
threads.note: Last mentioned Apr 2026; not repeated on the 2 calls since

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: You should expect a similar impact on what we have seen in the past annual increment cycle, which had been in the range of 150 to 200 basis points.

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: We are exiting FY26 at a four-year high on annual margins at 25%.

threads.note: Came due (FY26); the reported numbers can't confirm it. Last mentioned Jan 2026; not repeated on the 3 calls since

history.speaker: K Krithivasan

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: We expect the ongoing impact to be minimal, around 10 to 15 basis points.

history.quote: Overall, we are still optimistic that the demand will resume at some time in Q2, primarily because our customers have a significant amount of pent‑up technology backlog to be completed. I expect the demand to improve sometime in Q2.

threads.title: AI incremental revenue trend FY27
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: We are quite happy with the kind of growth we've been seeing on a quarter‑on‑quarter basis because of the non‑recurring nature of this work.

threads.note: Came due (Q1FY27); the reported numbers can't confirm it

threads.title: Growth outlook medium term
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: We remain confident that TCS is well positioned to convert demand into stronger growth as client spending normalizes and AI adoption scales across the enterprise.

threads.title: Long‑term EBIT margin target
threads.note: No reported number to check this against

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: See, we have always called 26%-28% as our guiding beacon, and we would not want to shift away from that. That is what rallies us to go towards it, and we are going to keep it at 26%-28%. And that's the long-term aspiration we'll work towards.

threads.title: North America revenue recovery
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: And we expect North America revenue to recover and become healthy soon.

threads.title: Consumer business growth outlook
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: In the medium term we are expecting growth to improve.

threads.title: ERU segment recovery
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: In the medium term we see structurally ERU should also recover.

threads.title: Overall medium‑term growth outlook
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: Overall, across multiple industry segments, looking at the TCV, looking at the client conversation, we are positive that medium-term growth should return.

threads.title: Margin trajectory near term
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: And we are looking towards inching up from here.

threads.title: Data center revenue timeline

history.speaker: Samir Seksaria
history.quote: And it will take about 18 to 24 months before the revenues start kicking in.

threads.title: India deferred revenue recovery
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: K Krithivasan
history.quote: And we expect it'll come back because there was a deferral, but we are very confident it will be back in the medium term.

threads.title: AI platform investment
threads.note: Qualitative promise

history.speaker: Krithi Krithivasan
history.quote: We will continue to execute with discipline, invest in differentiated capabilities, and help our clients achieve measurable outcomes in growth, productivity, and resilience.

synthesis.headline: Management falls short of FY27 margin targets, but FY26 margin meets promise

points.text: FY27 EBIT margin 23.97% vs promised 26% (T10, T19)
FY27 margin trend shows decline from 27.3% to 25.7% in Q2FY26 (F6)
Operating margin FY26 27.1% exceeds FY27 target of 26% (F2)

bull.text: FY26 EBIT margin 25.03% meets target, indicating strong execution
Operating margin FY26 27.1% above FY27 target, showing margin resilience

bear.text: FY27 EBIT margin 23.97% below promised 26%, indicating margin erosion
FY27 margin trend declining to 25.7% in Q2FY26, below medium‑term expectations
